title: Migrate JAXB from javax.xml.bind to jakarta.xml.bind
description:
The JAXB dependencies use the legacy javax.xml.bind namespace. Newer versions (4.x) use jakarta.xml.bind, so Dependabot bumps to jaxb-impl 4.0.7 crash the server at startup (ClassNotFoundException: com.sun.xml.internal.bind.v2.ContextFactory).

Migration steps:
1. Replace javax.xml.bind:jaxb-api:2.3.1 with jakarta.xml.bind:jakarta.xml.bind-api:4.0.x in pom.xml
2. Update com.sun.xml.bind:jaxb-impl from 2.3.1 to 4.0.x
3. Update org.glassfish.jaxb:jaxb-core from 3.0.2 to 4.0.x
4. Update maven-jaxb2-plugin to a version that generates jakarta.xml.bind annotations (or switch to a Jakarta-aware JAXB plugin)
5. Change import javax.xml.bind.* to import jakarta.xml.bind.* in Mage.Server/src/main/java/mage/server/util/ConfigFactory.java
6. Regenerate any JAXB-generated sources (mage.server.util.config package)

This is a namespace rename — same functionality, just the Java EE → Jakarta EE migration.
